entries.description: Read stub spec, prerequisite Set B UAT checklist, and project-guidance.md; verified API keys.
Promoted 'trust business + auditor backstop over auto-detection tooling' to Principle under Security And Organization Model in docs/planning/project-guidance.md.
Routed planning task to flesh out spec.md into per-session plan, risk notes, and exit criteria.

Spliced fleshed-out Session Plan (8 sessions), Risk notes, and Exit criteria into spec.md. Standardized Session 1's format (Steps/Creates/Touches/Progress keys/Ends with) to match downstream sessions. Updated Session 8 to explicitly include Playwright suite run and change-log generation via task_type='summarization' per prior lesson.

dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln: 0 errors, 183 warnings (all expected [Obsolete] cascades from Set B). dotnet test (non-Playwright): 0 failed, 667 passed across 6 assemblies (Dabbler.Components 33, Dabbler.Reports.Blazor 13, Dabbler.Security.Blazor 192, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api 27, Dabbler.Security 279, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web 123). Playwright suite intentionally skipped — Session 1 ships no behavioural change.
Cross-provider verification via task_type=session-verification. Verifier: opus. Raw review saved to session-reviews/session-001.md.

Addressed three Minor issues from round-1 verification: added Session 7 step 7 (new UX assertions) and step 8 (regression re-run); rewrote Finding 6 exit-criteria bullet to credit Sessions 4 and 7; added finding-6 co-reference to Session 7 step 2.
Round-2 cross-provider verification after fixing three Minor round-1 issues. Verifier: opus.
